text:
sam: Quick sync — refining intake checklist for design-sprint partners. Thinking small cohort (4–6) per sprint, 45min intake call + short pre-survey. Any must-haves?

jun: +1 on cohort size. Must capture product goal, ideal user persona, and current infra (hosted/dedicated/private).

leo: Also need to know throughput expectations & latency SLOs. If they want private deployment, note networking/KMS constraints up front.

maya: Incentives? We should offer credits + early roadmap access. Also confirm legal: NDA vs standard TOS.

arya: Legal flag — if customer needs on-prem images or HSM integration, tag as "high-touch" (require legal + infra pre-approval).

recruit-bot: pre-survey link posted: https://forms.example.com/dp-intake — includes basic contact, use-case, SLA needs, sample traffic.

sam: Draft intake checklist (suggested) — put this in the sheet and we can iterate:```
- Contact + project lead
- Primary use case & success metric (quant)
- Expected qps / peak tokens per minute
- Model preferences / size (open vs fine-tuned)
- Deployment mode required (hosted / dedicated / private)
- Data sensitivity (PII/regulated)
- Legal / compliance flags (SOC2, HIPAA, on-prem req)
- Preferred kickoff window
- Willingness to run short eval prompts + share outputs
```

jun: Add a field: "rollback & fallback tolerance" — i.e., acceptable behavior if we hit capacity. Also capture a short example prompt set.

leo: For selection signals, propose: 1) clear success metric, 2) ability to share eval prompts, 3) engineering contact for integration. If any of these missing, deprioritize.

maya: Success criteria idea: a) integration demo within 6 weeks, b) <x% inference error/regression vs baseline, c) usage >= threshold in pilot month. We can make thresholds configurable per partner.

arya: Ops checklist for "high-touch": plumbing for VPC peering, certs, KMS access, infra lead assigned. Mark as "requires 2-week lead time".

sam: Good. For recruitment messaging, keep it explicit: short ask (1 hr total), clear benefits (credits, influence, early access), and what we need (eval prompts, engineering time). Use subject line: "Design Sprint — Early Partner Invite" not too formal.

leo: Can we run a 1-week orientation: kickoff + quick eval run + feedback session? That reduces drop-off.

maya: I can run first 8 screening calls next Tue/Thu. Will use the new survey and share notes in this thread. :thumbsup:

recruit-bot: Survey responses so far: 7 submitted, 2 flagged for legal review.

sam: Action items: 1) finalize checklist in sheet (jun), 2) screening script (maya + sam), 3) ops pre-check template (arya + leo), 4) recruitment message + form (sam). Please update by EOD Fri. Confirm? :eyes:
